sfcSystems.name: Preparative Multi-Column Continuous SFC Skid (4x 50mm ID x 250mm, 350 bar, 2-Ethylpyridine)
sfcSystems.classification: Continuous Industrial Preparative SFC System (ASME BPVC Section VIII / cGMP / 3-A)
sfcSystems.description: Industrial automated multi-column continuous SFC purification system designed for high-throughput bioactive isolation and cannabinoid THC remediation. Features Coriolis mass flow metering, automated multi-port valve column switching, and dual cyclonic gas-liquid separation chambers for 98.5% CO2 recovery.

sfcSystems.name: Simulated Moving Bed Supercritical (SMB-SFC) Continuous Counter-Current Column Skid (8-Column Carousel)
sfcSystems.classification: Continuous Counter-Current SMB-SFC Fractionator (FDA 21 CFR § 111 / cGMP)
sfcSystems.stationaryPhase: High-Purity Diol / Polar Endcapped Spherical Silica (7 µm)
sfcSystems.description: Continuous simulated moving bed SFC skid utilizing an 8-column rotary carousel architecture. Emulates true counter-current solid-fluid flow, achieving maximum enantiomeric and isomer separation with lowest solvent consumption and continuous dual-stream extract/raffinate collection.

sfcSystems.name: Pilot High-Pressure SFC Fractionation & Isolation Skid (C18-PFP Bonded Silica, 20mm ID)
sfcSystems.classification: Pilot-Scale Sanitary Supercritical Separator (CE-PED / ASME VIII Div 1)
sfcSystems.stationaryPhase: Pentafluorophenyl (PFP) / Octadecyl C18 Bonded Silica (5 µm)
sfcSystems.description: High-precision pilot fractionation skid ideal for isolating thermolabile marine carotenoids (astaxanthin) and omega-3 fatty acid ethyl esters under inert CO2 atmosphere, completely eliminating thermal degradation and auto-oxidation.

sfcSystems.name: Compromised High-Pressure Column with Packing Void & Gasket Extrusion (Channeling & Pressure Spikes)
sfcSystems.classification: HAZARDOUS / NON-COMPLIANT (ASME Overpressure Blowout & Chromatographic Failure)
sfcSystems.stationaryPhase: Fractured / Settled Silica Bed with Channeling Voids
sfcSystems.description: Severely degraded preparative column exhibiting stationary phase bed collapse, severe fluid channeling, and extruded PTFE/PEEK end-fitting gaskets. Produces severe axial dispersion, total loss of peak resolution, and hazardous pressure spikes exceeding ASME safety thresholds.

feedstockBioactives.name: Industrial Broad-Spectrum Hemp Cannabinoid Extract (CBD / CBG Isolation & THC Remediation)
feedstockBioactives.regulatoryStandard: 2018 US Farm Bill (<0.3% THC) / EU GMP Part II (<0.01% Non-Detectable THC)
feedstockBioactives.description: Decarboxylated crude hemp extract requiring precise chromatographic separation of psychotropic THC from therapeutic CBD/CBG. Continuous SFC provides near-zero solvent waste and complete remediation without synthetic isomerization.

feedstockBioactives.name: Haematococcus pluvialis Marine Microalgae Astaxanthin (All-Trans & Cis Isomer Isolation)
feedstockBioactives.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS Notice GRN 000580 / USP Dietary Supplement Monograph
feedstockBioactives.description: High-value natural antioxidant oleoresin. Extremely thermolabile and sensitive to oxidative bleaching. Supercritical CO2 maintains an inert, pressurized anaerobic environment that isolates the potent all-trans isomer at 100% biological activity.

feedstockBioactives.name: Refined Marine Fish Oil Ethyl Esters (High-Purity EPA & DHA Fractionation)
feedstockBioactives.regulatoryStandard: US Pharmacopeia (USP) / European Pharmacopoeia (Ph. Eur.) Pure EPA Standard
feedstockBioactives.description: Transesterified marine lipid feed requiring separation of omega-3 long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids. High solubility in dense supercritical CO2 permits high column loading with zero thermal polymerization.

feedstockBioactives.name: Unwinterized Crude Botanical Oleoresin with High Wax Content (Bed Plugging & Pressure Spikes)
feedstockBioactives.feedstockType: HAZARDOUS / UNWINTERIZED (High Paraffinic Plant Waxes & Phospholipids)
feedstockBioactives.regulatoryStandard: NON-COMPLIANT (Severe Pre-Column Frit Fouling & Fluid Channeling)
feedstockBioactives.description: Unrefined botanical crude loaded with insoluble waxes and phospholipids. Causes rapid precipitation at column inlet frits, inducing massive pressure drop across the bed, fluid channeling, and emergency overpressure shutdowns.

modifierSolvents.name: USP / Food-Grade Anhydrous Pure Ethanol (200 Proof, 5-25% v/v Modifier)
modifierSolvents.solventType: Class 3 Non-Toxic Green Co-Solvent (FDA 21 CFR § 184.1293 / ICH Q3C)
modifierSolvents.flammabilityClass: Class IB Flammable Liquid (NFPA 30 / ATEX Zone 1)
modifierSolvents.description: Primary organic modifier for food, beverage, and nutraceutical SFC applications. Modulates the dielectric constant and solvent strength of supercritical CO2, enabling the eluting of moderately polar bioactives while maintaining full FDA food-grade compliance and simple evaporative recycling.

modifierSolvents.name: Ultra-Pure Food-Contact Isopropanol (IPA, 5-15% v/v Modifier)
modifierSolvents.solventType: Class 3 Secondary Alcohol Modifier (USP / Ph. Eur.)
modifierSolvents.description: Secondary alcohol modifier providing specialized selectivity for aromatic and stereoisomeric bioactives. Slightly higher viscosity increases column backpressure but sharpens peak resolution for complex lipid fractions.

modifierSolvents.name: High-Purity Supercritical CO2 Neat (100% Green Solvent-Free Lipophilic Elution)
modifierSolvents.description: Pure carbon dioxide operating in the supercritical fluid region (T > 31.1°C, P > 73.8 bar). Completely non-toxic, non-flammable, and residue-free. Ideal for low-polarity lipid esters and terpenoids requiring 100% solvent-free dry extract collection.

modifierSolvents.name: Hydrated Recycled Ethanol (>8.5% Water Contamination & Denaturant Impurities)
modifierSolvents.solventType: HAZARDOUS / OFF-SPEC (High Water Content & Stationary Phase Leaching)
modifierSolvents.description: Off-spec recycled solvent containing excessive dissolved water. Destabilizes the single-phase supercritical fluid boundary, strips polar stationary phase ligands from silica packings, and causes severe baseline noise and retention drift.

reliefOverpressureSystems.name: Dual Inconel 625 Rupture Disc with Inter-Space Sensor & ASME BPV Sanitary Relief Skid
reliefOverpressureSystems.safetyRating: ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 1 (UV Stamp) / API 520 / 3-A Sanitary
reliefOverpressureSystems.ventContainment: Hermetically Piped to Low-Pressure Scrubber & Gas Storage Sphere
reliefOverpressureSystems.certifications: ASME Section VIII, CE PED Cat IV, ATEX Ex d IIB T4
reliefOverpressureSystems.description: Dual forward-acting Inconel rupture disc assembly with intermediate pressure sensor to detect disc pinholes or premature creep. Backed by high-speed ASME UV-stamped safety relief valve vented to an enclosed closed-loop containment system, eliminating hazardous room overpressurization.

reliefOverpressureSystems.name: High-Pressure Pilot-Operated Proportional Relief Valve with Rupture Backup (320 bar)
reliefOverpressureSystems.safetyRating: ASME BPVC Section VIII / ISO 4126 High-Pressure Safety Standard
reliefOverpressureSystems.ventContainment: Controlled Orifice Pressure Bleed to Cyclonic Condenser
reliefOverpressureSystems.certifications: ASME VIII, CRN registered (Canadian Registration Number)
reliefOverpressureSystems.description: Precision proportional safety relief valve designed for high-pressure supercritical fluids. Re-seats automatically after transient pressure excursions, minimizing costly batch shutdowns while maintaining full ASME code protection.

reliefOverpressureSystems.name: Corroded / Clogged Emergency Rupture Disc Line with Stuck Valve Seat (Catastrophic Overpressure)
reliefOverpressureSystems.ventContainment: BLOCKED / RESTRICTED (Risk of Shrapnel & Vessel Rupture)
reliefOverpressureSystems.description: Critically compromised relief assembly choked with crystallized botanical resin and corroded disc seat. Burst pressure shifted dangerously above column vessel design limits (>440 bar), exposing operators to catastrophic vessel shrapnel blowout during pressure excursions.
